launcher.title: Take action

scope.global: Record something across the whole laboratory.

launcher.loadFailed: The information needed for actions could not be loaded.
launcher.unitMissing: This unit could not be found, or you do not have access to it.
launcher.readOnly: You can view this record but not change it. Only administrators and members of its experiment can take action on it.
launcher.emptyBody: Your role or the current status of this record does not allow any action. Nothing has been changed.
launcher.footer: Every action is written to the audit trail with your name and the time.

new_experiment.title: New experiment
new_experiment.description: Start an experiment and register its first material.

new_sub_experiment.title: Sub-experiment
new_sub_experiment.description: Start a child experiment from this unit.

register_units.title: Register units
register_units.description: Add new samples that originate in your laboratory.

receive_units.title: Receive units
receive_units.description: Record material received from another organization.

derive.title: Derive from this unit
derive.description: Take a clone or cutting, or start a subculture. The parent stays in inventory.

change_stage.title: Change stage
change_stage.description: Report that the unit entered a new stage, with the date it happened.

measure.title: Record a measurement
measure.description: Enter new weights or a new seed count.

move.title: Move
move.description: Transfer the unit to another location, confirmed by its barcode.

ship.title: Ship
ship.description: Create an outbound shipment for this unit.

place_hold.title: Place a hold
place_hold.description: Freeze the unit while a quality question is open.

release_hold.title: Release the hold
release_hold.description: Lift the hold after review. Needs a reason.

destroy.title: Destroy
destroy.description: Record the destruction of this unit, with a witness.

log_activity.title: Log an activity
log_activity.description: Nutrients, treatments, scouting or environmental readings.

attach_file.title: Attach a file
attach_file.description: A photo, protocol or certificate kept with the unit.

issues.rangeBetween: Enter a value from {min, number} to {max, number}.
issues.mismatch: This does not match the barcode of this unit.
issues.future: The date cannot be in the future.
issues.unchanged: Choose something different from the current value.

experiment.body: Experiments are created on their own page, with a guided form that keeps your draft. Nothing is saved until you finish there.
experiment.subBody: The sub-experiment form opens with {name} already filled in as its starting unit.

register.missingLists: At least one cultivar and one active location must exist before units can be registered. Add them from the Cultivars and Locations pages.
register.nameHint: With a quantity above 1 this is the base name: NAME-1, NAME-2 and so on.
register.sourceHint: Say where this material comes from (stock, an older unit, a collection), at least 10 characters.
register.providerHint: The organization the material came from.
register.receiptHint: Optional. A manifest number or a note about the delivery.

derive.parent: Parent: {name}. The parent is not changed and stays in inventory.
derive.name: Name (optional)
derive.nameHint: Leave empty to name them automatically from {name}.

move.barcodeHint: Scan or type the barcode to confirm you are moving the right unit. For this unit it reads {name}.

stage.dateHint: Back-date this if the change happened earlier. Stage durations are counted from this date. Future dates are not accepted.

measure.weightIntro: Enter the weights you measured for {name}. Leave a field empty to keep its last value.
measure.countIntro: Enter the new seed count for {name}.
measure.dateHint: The date of the measurement. Future dates are not accepted.

hold.effect: While {name} is on hold it cannot be moved, derived from, changed in stage, shipped or destroyed. Only an administrator can release it.
hold.reasonHint: At least {count, number} characters. This is part of the quality record.

release.effect: Releasing the hold lets the unit be moved, derived from, shipped and destroyed again. Your reason becomes part of the audit trail.
release.confirmBody: State why it is safe to release this unit. You may be asked to confirm your password.

destroy.warning: {name} will leave inventory. The record cannot be edited or removed afterwards, and it is listed in the destruction register.
destroy.noWitnesses: No other active member is available to act as witness. Ask an administrator to invite someone first.
destroy.witnessHint: A member other than you who saw the destruction.
destroy.confirmBody: This writes a permanent destruction record. It cannot be undone. You may be asked to confirm your password.
destroy.reasonHint: At least {count, number} characters. Regulators read this.

ship.recipientHint: The receiving organization. Add organizations from the Organizations page.
ship.licenceHint: Left empty, the licence number on the organization record is used.
ship.dispatchNowHint: Records the unit as shipped immediately. Leave unticked to save a draft and dispatch it later from the shipment.
ship.dispatchWarning: {name} will leave inventory as soon as you confirm. This cannot be undone.

attach.label: Label
attach.fileHint: PDF, image, CSV or text, up to {megabytes, number} MB. The type is checked from the file contents.
attach.tooLarge: This file is larger than {megabytes, number} MB.

done.register_units: {count, plural, one {Unit {name} registered.} other {# units registered, starting with {name}.}}
done.receive_units: {count, plural, one {Unit {name} received.} other {# units received, starting with {name}.}}
done.derive: {count, plural, one {{kind, select, clone {Clone {name} created from {parent}.} cutting {Cutting {name} created from {parent}.} other {Subculture {name} created from {parent}.}}} other {# units created from {parent}, starting with {name}.}}
done.ship: {sent, select, yes {Unit {name} shipped on {reference}.} other {Draft shipment {reference} created for {name}.}}
